name: Fantasy
description: A cozy guild town: carved wood and brass, parchment, and a leather-bound book for every conversation.

text.headquarters-empty: The guild hall is empty: no coordinator is running.
text.register-greeting: {here} asleep here{upstairs}. Whom shall I wake?
text.register-empty: Every bed is made and every table free: nobody sleeps here tonight.
text.letter-for-sleeper: {name} is asleep at the inn: the letter waits until it wakes.
text.rookery-greeting: {waiting}Shall I send a bird for you?
text.rookery-empty: No birds have flown yet today. Shall I send one for you?
text.end-session-after: Its pane closes and it goes to the inn to sleep; you can wake it there.
text.session-ended: {name}'s session ended; it goes to the inn to sleep.
text.conversation-asleep: {name} is asleep at the inn. Wake it to talk; it opens in a new terminal window.
text.quest-greeting: {count} quests bear your name. Pick one, or search the archive for any other.
text.quest-greeting-one: One quest bears your name. Or search the archive for any other.
text.quest-empty: No quest bears your name just now. The archive holds every other.
text.quest-signed-out: I pin quests only for a member with a guild seal. Sign in to Atlassian in Settings, and the board fills.
text.quest-search: Search every quest by words or key
text.library-greeting: Every scroll in Confluence is catalogued here. What do you seek?
text.library-signed-out: The stacks open to readers with a library seal. Sign in to Atlassian in Settings.
text.library-recent-empty: Nothing read yet. Pages you open here are kept on this shelf.
text.crier-greeting: Hear ye! {count} channels have news for you. Name any channel, read or not, and I'll cry it out.
text.crier-quiet: All is quiet in the channels. Name any one, and I'll cry out what was said.
text.crier-signed-out: I can't hear Slack yet, friend. Sign in, and every channel's news is mine to cry.
text.forge-greeting: Every piece on these benches is yours or your guild's. Which shall we look over?
text.forge-empty: The benches are bare: nothing of yours or your guild's is open on GitHub.
text.forge-loading: Let me see what's on the benches…
text.recruit-worker-greeting: Another pair of hands for the guild? Give them a name, a repository to work in, and their first quest.
text.recruit-independent-greeting: Seeking a wanderer for a job? Name them, point them to a repository, and tell them the quest. They answer to no guild.
text.recruit-sending: A runner sets off to fetch {name}…

pet.name: Ginger cat
pet.examine: {name}, the inn's ginger cat. Keeps the mice honest and the hearth warm.

cat-black.name: Black cat
cat-black.examine: {name}, the library's black cat, asleep on the warmest shelf. Brings luck, mostly to itself.

hound.name: Hound
hound.examine: {name}, the smith's hound. Sleeps by the forge and fears only the bellows.

owl.name: Barn owl
owl.examine: {name}, the rookery's barn owl. It judges every letter that comes in.

rabbit.name: Lop rabbit
rabbit.examine: {name}, a lop-eared rabbit who has claimed the square's best patch of clover.

bell.name: Brass bell
bell.examine: A bell on a little oak stand. Ring it, and someone ought to come.

handbell.name: Handbell
handbell.examine: A small brass handbell with a worn wooden grip.

light.name: Candelabra
light.examine: Three tall candles on a wrought-iron candelabra.

box.name: Music box
box.examine: A carved music box. A tiny dancer waits inside for her tune.

candle.name: Candle
candle.examine: A fat candle in a brass holder, burning low and steady.

tome.name: Open tome
tome.examine: A heavy tome left open, its margins full of someone's notes.
lines: "Here be dragons; also, the build passes on the second try."
"A recipe for honey cakes, and a note: never deploy on a Friday."
"Chapter IX: Of Merges, and the Conflicts Thereof."
"The map's edge says only: further work, see ticket."
"A pressed flower falls out. Somebody's bookmark."

spin.name: Desk globe
spin.examine: A brass desk globe. Someone has inked a small star over home.

bard.name: Pip the bard
bard.examine: A bard with a lute, a feathered cap, and rather more confidence than chords.
lines: Ah, an audience! Well, half of one. You'll do.
I'm writing a ballad about your guild. So far it rhymes 'quest' with 'rest' fourteen times.
The innkeeper pays me in stew. Best contract I ever signed.
Every song needs a chorus, and every chorus needs someone to hum along. That's you, friend.
If you hear a lute at three in the morning, that was the cat. Mostly.
I once played for a king. He clapped, then he left. I'm counting it.
reactions: Easy, easy! The lute's in tune. My nerves are not.
An encore already? I haven't finished the first verse!
barks: Requests? None? The long one, then!

guard.name: Bertram the guard
guard.examine: A guard leaning on his spear by the guild hall doors, heroically awake. Mostly.
lines: Halt! Who goes... oh, it's you. Carry on. Quietly, please.
I'm not asleep. I'm guarding with my eyes closed. Advanced technique.
Nothing has happened on my watch in eleven years. I like to think that's me.
The guildmaster calls me 'decorative'. I've decided that's a compliment.
The spear's for ceremony, mostly. And for leaning. Mainly leaning.
reactions: Hrm? Wha? I'm up! I'm up!
Five more minutes, then I'll stand to attention. Promise.

baker.name: Marjorie the baker
baker.examine: A baker with a basket of warm rolls and a fresher basket of news.
lines: Fresh rolls! And fresher news: the smith's been humming. Humming! Something's afoot.
Don't tell a soul, but the librarian dog-eared a page. On purpose.
The crier gets all his news from me, you know. He just says it louder.
A new wanderer joined the guild, I hear. Lovely manners. Takes the bread unbuttered.
Gossip's like sourdough, dearie. Give it a night and it rises on its own.
reactions: Ooh, you want the juicy bit! Closer... closer... it's a cinnamon bun. Gotcha.
Patience, love. The best stories come out of the oven last.
barks: Did you hear? No? Come here, then.

tourist.name: Ottilie the traveller
tourist.examine: A traveller holding a map upside down, beaming at everything.
lines: Excuse me, is this the harbour? My map says there's a dragon here.
I came all this way for the famous fountain. It's very... wet. Lovely, though!
Everyone's so busy here. Back home the big news is the weather.
I've walked in circles for an hour. On the bright side, I've met that seagull four times.
I bought a souvenir sword. The smith says it's a butter knife. I'm keeping it.
reactions: Oh! Are you the guide? Please say you're the guide.
Sorry, sorry, I'll move! Which way is 'move'?
barks: Left at the fountain... or right?
